title: Field3 authentic precision cleanarch capacity
objective: Generalize the packed field3 class cleanarch and required workspaces to authenticated 153088-bit inputs without changing PARI operation order or failure semantics

handoff.summary: Active focused lane raises the field3 packed class-cleanarch boundary to 153088 bits, derives exact pi coefficient/stack capacities, and updates C7 to allocate those capacities. Generated low inputs match pristine PARI 2.17.4; bounded high neutral/synthetic CPython, native low differential/preflight, C7 correspondence, and strict checks pass.
risks: An initial negative-test design allocated maximum-width native coefficient arrays and reached about 4.9 GiB RSS; campaign supervision stopped it. The corrected checker uses sparse CPython lists for high cold capacity and truly empty native negative workspaces, and passes under an inherited 3 GiB address-space cap.
The successful initial 153088-bit JavaScript/GMP/tagged synthetic outputs are incident evidence only and are not rerun or claimed as an accepted receipt after the resource failure.
No authentic 153088-bit Ce replay, broad native/architecture suite, or cross-platform gate was run.
next_steps: Replay the immutable authentic Ce owner only in an explicitly authorized resource-controlled integration campaign.
Run full native, architecture, and required platform gates after integration.
Keep future high-precision buffer tests capacity-aware; never allocate maximum bit capacity for every coefficient cell merely to test a preflight failure.
